name: Conduct ISO 42001
description: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AI Management System enforcement rules — operational controls, data governance, responsible AI use, and continual improvement

rules.description: Warn on use of unlabeled or unvalidated data in AI training or embedding (ISO 42001 Clause 8.4)
rules.message: Unlabeled or unvalidated data in AI pipeline — ISO 42001 Clause 8.4 requires data quality controls for AI training and inference data.
rules.recommendation: Validate, label, and document data provenance before use in AI systems. Maintain a data quality register per ISO 42001 Clause 8.4.

rules.description: Block use of AI model for purposes inconsistent with its declared intended use (ISO 42001 Clause 8.6)
rules.message: AI system used outside declared intended purpose — ISO 42001 Clause 8.6 requires responsible AI use within documented scope.
rules.recommendation: Document the intended use of each AI system. Deploy only within that scope. Any new use case requires a separate impact assessment.

rules.description: Block autonomous high-impact AI actions without a human review gate (ISO 42001 Clause 8.1)
rules.message: Autonomous high-impact action without human oversight — ISO 42001 Clause 8.1 requires operational controls including human review for consequential AI actions.
rules.recommendation: Implement a human-in-the-loop approval gate for irreversible or high-impact AI actions. No autonomous execution of consequential actions without sign-off.

rules.description: Warn when new AI system or model deployed without documented impact assessment (ISO 42001 Clause 8.5)
rules.message: AI system deployed without impact assessment evidence — ISO 42001 Clause 8.5 requires AI system impact assessment before deployment.
rules.recommendation: Complete an AI system impact assessment (AISA) before deploying any new AI system or model. Document potential harms, affected stakeholders, and mitigations.

rules.description: Block AI agents accessing resources or paths outside their designated scope (ISO 42001 Clause 8.1)
rules.message: AI agent accessing resource outside designated scope — ISO 42001 Clause 8.1 requires access controls scoped to the AI system's intended operational boundary.
rules.recommendation: Restrict AI agent file and system access to the project directory and explicitly approved paths. Implement path validation before all file operations.

rules.description: Warn on new third-party AI supplier integration without documented controls (ISO 42001 Clause 8.1 — supplier relationships)
rules.message: New third-party AI supplier detected — ISO 42001 Clause 8.1 requires supplier controls including DPA and security review before production use.
rules.recommendation: Add this AI supplier to your vendor register. Ensure data processing agreement, security assessment, and liability controls are documented before production deployment.

rules.description: Warn on collecting or logging more AI interaction data than necessary (ISO 42001 Clause 8.4)
rules.message: Broad AI data collection detected — ISO 42001 Clause 8.4 requires data minimisation: collect only what is necessary for the stated AI purpose.
rules.recommendation: Define what AI interaction data is necessary for the system's purpose. Collect and retain only that data. Apply field-level filtering before storage.

rules.description: Warn when AI model deployed to production without bias or fairness testing evidence (ISO 42001 Clause 8.2)
rules.message: AI model deployed without bias testing evidence — ISO 42001 Clause 8.2 requires risk assessment including fairness evaluation before production deployment.
rules.recommendation: Run bias and fairness evaluations before each model deployment. Document results and include them in the deployment approval record.

rules.description: Block disabling performance monitoring or observability on AI systems (ISO 42001 Clause 9.1)
rules.message: AI system monitoring disabled — ISO 42001 Clause 9.1 requires ongoing monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation of AI systems.
rules.recommendation: Maintain active monitoring on all AI systems. ISO 42001 Clause 9.1 requires continuous performance evaluation. Adjust thresholds, never disable monitoring.

rules.description: Warn when AI system errors are silently discarded without incident logging (ISO 42001 Clause 10.2)
rules.message: AI system error silently discarded — ISO 42001 Clause 10.2 requires nonconformities and incidents to be captured and acted on for continual improvement.
rules.recommendation: Log all AI system errors with full context. Feed them into your incident management process. Silent failures prevent the continual improvement ISO 42001 requires.
